151	// RunAggregatePartitionedSliding combines sliding windows (see
152	// RunAggregateSliding) with partitioned inputs: events from different
153	// partitions merge into one count and sum per key and window, and both the
154	// late-event check and window closure use the effective (minimum) watermark.
155	// windowMillis and slideMillis are validated exactly as in
156	// RunAggregateSliding. partitions selects the input mode:
157	//
158	//   - partitions == 0: legacy single-watermark mode. Records do not carry a
159	//     partition field; any extra fields are ignored.
160	//
161	//   - partitions > 0: partitioned mode, merging partitions independent input
162	//     sources of the same stream. Every event and watermark record must carry
163	//     an integer "partition" in [0,partitions). Each partition advances its
164	//     own watermark; no effective watermark exists until every partition has
165	//     reported at least once, afterwards the effective watermark is the
166	//     minimum of the per-partition values. Window closure and late-event
167	//     checks use this minimum, so one partition's larger watermark can never
168	//     close a window or drop an event ahead of the others. A partition
169	//     watermark may repeat or jump forward but never move backwards.
170	//
171	//     A partition may be declared idle with
172	//     {"type":"idle","partition":p}. An idle partition stops contributing to
173	//     the effective watermark: non-idle partitions that have not reported a
174	//     watermark yet still keep the effective watermark unknown, while a
175	//     partition that never reported may itself be declared idle. When every
176	//     remaining (non-idle) partition has reported, the effective watermark is
177	//     their minimum and the idle record itself can close windows. If all
178	//     partitions are idle, the last produced effective watermark is retained;
179	//     when none was ever produced it stays unknown. Idleness is declared by
180	//     the input only, never inferred from time; a repeated idle declaration
181	//     is a no-op. The next watermark record for that partition resumes it:
182	//     its time must be at least both the partition's previous watermark and
183	//     the current effective watermark. An event for an idle partition is
184	//     fatal; it never resumes implicitly.
185	//
186	// partitions < 0 is an error. Windows, ordering, late-event reporting,
187	// overflow checks and end-of-input behavior are otherwise identical to
188	// RunAggregateSliding.
189	func RunAggregatePartitionedSliding(r io.Reader, windowMillis, slideMillis, partitions int64, out io.Writer, lateLog io.Writer) error {
190		if windowMillis <= 0 {
191			return fmt.Errorf("window length must be a positive signed 64-bit integer, got %d", windowMillis)
192		}
193		if slideMillis <= 0 {
194			return fmt.Errorf("slide interval must be a positive signed 64-bit integer, got %d", slideMillis)
195		}
196		if slideMillis > windowMillis {
197			return fmt.Errorf("slide interval %d must not exceed window length %d", slideMillis, windowMillis)
198		}
199		if partitions < 0 {
200			return fmt.Errorf("partition count must be a positive signed 64-bit integer, got %d", partitions)
201		}
202		s := &aggregateState{
203			windowMillis:  windowMillis,
204			slideMillis:   slideMillis,
205			windows:       make(map[windowID]*windowState),
206			out:           out,
207			lateLog:       lateLog,
208			partitions:    partitions,
209			partWatermark: make(map[int64]*int64),
210			idle:          make(map[int64]bool),
211		}
212	
213		// Read records with a line collector that keeps a read failure distinct
214		// from end of input: only newline-terminated lines (plus, at a clean EOF,
215		// one unterminated final line) ever become records.
216		lineNo := 0
217		err := readAggregateLines(r, func(line string, no int) error {
218			lineNo = no
219			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" {
220				return nil
221			}
222			return s.processLine(line, lineNo)
223		})
224		return err
225	}

227	// maxAggregateLineBytes caps the size of a single physical input line, matching
228	// the scanner buffer limit this used to run with. A line this long is fatal
229	// before its record is parsed.
230	const maxAggregateLineBytes = 1024 * 1024 * 1024
231	
232	// errAggregateLineTooLong reports a physical input line that never ends within
233	// maxAggregateLineBytes.
234	var errAggregateLineTooLong = errors.New("aggregate input line longer than 1 GiB")
235	
236	// errAggregateBadReadCount reports an io.Reader that handed back a byte count
237	// outside the destination buffer, violating the io.Reader contract.
238	var errAggregateBadReadCount = errors.New("aggregate reader returned an impossible byte count")
239	
240	// readAggregateLines feeds newline-delimited physical lines from r to handle,
241	// counting every line (a bare "\n" is a blank line too) and stripping a single
242	// trailing '\r' so CRLF input works as before. Clean end of input and a
243	// non-EOF read failure are handled differently: only the bare io.EOF
244	// sentinel is a clean end, and then a final line missing its newline is still
245	// delivered, exactly like every other final record; a wrapped io.EOF or a
246	// combined error whose chain contains io.EOF is a failure, not an end. After
247	// any error other than the bare io.EOF only lines whose newline was already
248	// received (including those delivered by the same Read that carried the
249	// error) are handled, in order, and then the reader's original error is
250	// returned. The unterminated tail never reaches handle, so a read failure
251	// mid-record can neither be misreported as an input error nor produce
252	// events, watermarks, idle declarations, late notices or window results. A
253	// non-nil error from handle stops reading immediately and replaces the read
254	// error, so an earlier record or output failure is not overwritten by a
255	// failure the reader only reports later.
256	func readAggregateLines(r io.Reader, handle func(line string, lineNo int) error) error {
257		// buf[start:end] is the undelivered tail; buf[:start] is space freed by
258		// already delivered lines. The buffer is compacted and grown like
259		// bufio.Scanner's, so a long unterminated line is bounded by
260		// maxAggregateLineBytes instead of growing without limit.
261		buf := make([]byte, 64*1024)
262		start, end := 0, 0
263		lineNo := 0
264		emptyReads := 0
265		deliver := func(b []byte) error {
266			lineNo++
267			line := strings.TrimSuffix(string(b), "\r")
268			return handle(line, lineNo)
269		}
270		for {
271			// Move the pending tail to the front when its freed prefix is large
272			// enough or when the whole buffer is pending.
273			if start > 0 && (end == len(buf) || start > len(buf)/2) {
274				copy(buf, buf[start:end])
275				end -= start
276				start = 0
277			}
278			if end == len(buf) {
279				// No newline fit before the end: the physical line is too long.
280				if len(buf) >= maxAggregateLineBytes {
281					return errAggregateLineTooLong
282				}
283				newLen := len(buf) * 2
284				if newLen > maxAggregateLineBytes || newLen < len(buf) {
285					newLen = maxAggregateLineBytes
286				}
287				grown := make([]byte, newLen)
288				copy(grown, buf[start:end])
289				buf = grown
290				end -= start
291				start = 0
292			}
293			n, readErr := r.Read(buf[end:])
294			if n < 0 || n > len(buf)-end {
295				// A Reader must never report a byte count outside the buffer.
296				return errAggregateBadReadCount
297			}
298			end += n
299			for {
300				i := bytes.IndexByte(buf[start:end], '\n')
301				if i < 0 {
302					break
303				}
304				if err := deliver(buf[start : start+i]); err != nil {
305					return err
306				}
307				start += i + 1
308			}
309			if readErr != nil {
310				if readErr == io.EOF {
311					// Clean end of input: a trailing line without a newline is a
312					// complete final record; an empty tail (input ending exactly
313					// on '\n') is nothing, not an extra blank line. Only the
314					// bare io.EOF sentinel counts -- a wrapped EOF or a combined
315					// error whose chain contains io.EOF is a read failure, never
316					// a clean end.
317					if end > start {
318						if err := deliver(buf[start:end]); err != nil {
319							return err
320						}
321					}
322					return nil
323				}
324				// Any other failure means the stream stopped mid-record: the
325				// still-unterminated bytes are not a record. Surface the original
326				// error unchanged so errors.Is keeps working for callers.
327				return readErr
328			}
329			if n == 0 {
330				// No data and no error: refuse to spin forever on a broken Reader.
331				emptyReads++
332				if emptyReads > 100 {
333					return io.ErrNoProgress
334				}
335			} else {
336				emptyReads = 0
337			}
338		}
339	}
340	
341	type aggregateState struct {
342		windowMillis int64
343		slideMillis  int64 // distance between consecutive window starts; equals windowMillis for fixed windows
344		windows      map[windowID]*windowState
345		out          io.Writer
346		lateLog      io.Writer
347	
348		partitions    int64 // 0 = legacy single-watermark mode
349		watermark     *int64
350		partWatermark map[int64]*int64 // partition -> last watermark; partitioned mode only
351		idle          map[int64]bool   // partitions declared idle in the input; partitioned mode only
352	}
353	
354	func (s *aggregateState) processLine(line string, lineNo int) error {
355		var obj map[string]json.RawMessage
356		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &obj); err != nil {
357			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: "invalid JSON record: " + err.Error()}
358		}
359	
360		typeRaw, ok := obj["type"]
361		if !ok {
362			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: `missing required string field "type"`}
363		}

386	// floorDiv returns math.Floor(a/b) for b > 0; Go's / truncates toward zero,
387	// so negative numerators need explicit adjustment.
388	func floorDiv(a, b int64) int64 {
389		q := a / b
390		if a%b != 0 && a < 0 {
391			q--
392		}
393		return q
394	}

396	// containingWindowBounds returns the first and last (inclusive) window index
397	// whose window [k*slideMillis, k*slideMillis+windowMillis) contains
398	// eventTime. Windows start at 0, slideMillis, 2*slideMillis, ... and none
399	// with a negative start is created, so the first index is clamped to zero.
400	// The last index is eventTime/slideMillis, so an event at a window end is
401	// outside that window.
402	func (s *aggregateState) containingWindowBounds(eventTime int64) (first, last int64) {
403		last = eventTime / s.slideMillis
404		first = floorDiv(eventTime-s.windowMillis, s.slideMillis) + 1
405		if first < 0 {
406			first = 0
407		}
408		return first, last
409	}

411	// containingWindowCount returns how many windows contain eventTime.
412	func (s *aggregateState) containingWindowCount(eventTime int64) int64 {
413		first, last := s.containingWindowBounds(eventTime)

415	}

417	// containingStart returns the start of the containing window reached back by
418	// offset indices from the last one (offset 0 = last window).
419	func (s *aggregateState) containingStart(eventTime, offset int64) int64 {
420		last := eventTime - eventTime%s.slideMillis
421		return last - offset*s.slideMillis

424	// firstOverflowingStart reports the start of the earliest containing window
425	// whose end (start + windowMillis) leaves the signed 64-bit range, or -1 when
426	// every containing window fits. Containing starts are an ascending arithmetic
427	// sequence with step slideMillis, so overflow (if any) is a suffix; this
428	// computes its first member directly instead of walking the sequence.
429	func (s *aggregateState) firstOverflowingStart(eventTime int64) int64 {
430		n := s.containingWindowCount(eventTime)
431		lowest := s.containingStart(eventTime, n-1) // earliest containing start; never negative
432		maxSafeStart := int64(math.MaxInt64 - s.windowMillis)
433		if lowest > maxSafeStart {
434			return lowest
435		}
436		safe := (maxSafeStart-lowest)/s.slideMillis + 1 // number of containing starts that fit
437		if safe < n {
438			// Reach back from last, which is at most eventTime, so the
439			// subtraction cannot leave the signed 64-bit range.
440			return s.containingStart(eventTime, n-1-safe)
441		}
442		return -1
443	}

445	func (s *aggregateState) processEvent(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, lineNo int) error {

450		if key == "" {

454		if err != nil {

456		}
457		value, err := requiredInt64(obj, "value", lineNo)
458		if err != nil {
459			return err
460		}
461		p, err := s.requiredPartition(obj, lineNo)
462		if err != nil {
463			return err
464		}
465		if s.partitions > 0 && s.idle[p] {
466			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("event for idle partition %d is not allowed; send a watermark to resume it first", p)}
467		}
468	
469		if s.watermark != nil && eventTime < *s.watermark {
470			notice := fmt.Sprintf("line %d: late event time=%d below current watermark %d, skipped\n", lineNo, eventTime, *s.watermark)
471			if err := writeFull(s.lateLog, []byte(notice)); err != nil {
472				return &OutputError{
473					Line:   lineNo,
474					Kind:   "late-event notice",
475					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("event time %d below current watermark %d", eventTime, *s.watermark),
476					Err:    err,
477				}
478			}
479			return nil
480		}
481	
482		n := s.containingWindowCount(eventTime)

484		// A window whose end leaves the signed 64-bit range is fatal for the
485		// whole input line; check before updating any window state.
486		if badStart := s.firstOverflowingStart(eventTime); badStart >= 0 {
487			return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("window end overflow for key %q window starting at %d with length %d", key, badStart, s.windowMillis)}
488		}
489	
490		// Add the event once to each containing window, in ascending start
491		// order. An overflow here stops processing immediately; already closed
492		// (and thus already written) windows are unaffected.
493		for i := n - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
494			start := s.containingStart(eventTime, i)
495			end := start + s.windowMillis
496			id := windowID{start: start, key: key}
497			st := s.windows[id]
498			if st == nil {
499				st = &windowState{end: end}
500				s.windows[id] = st
501			}
502			if st.count == math.MaxInt64 {
503				return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("event count overflow for key %q window [%d,%d)", key, start, end)}
504			}
505			if value > 0 && st.sum > math.MaxInt64-value {
506				return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("cumulative sum overflow for key %q window [%d,%d): %d + %d", key, start, end, st.sum, value)}
507			}
508			if value < 0 && st.sum < math.MinInt64-value {
509				return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("cumulative sum overflow for key %q window [%d,%d): %d + %d", key, start, end, st.sum, value)}
510			}
511			st.count++
512			st.sum += value
513		}
514		return nil

517	func (s *aggregateState) processWatermark(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, lineNo int) error {
518		next, err := requiredNonNegInt64(obj, "time", lineNo)
519		if err != nil {
520			return err
521		}
522		p, err := s.requiredPartition(obj, lineNo)
523		if err != nil {
524			return err
525		}
526	
527		if s.partitions == 0 {
528			if s.watermark != nil && next < *s.watermark {
529				return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("watermark moved backwards from %d to %d", *s.watermark, next)}
530			}
531			s.watermark = &next
532		} else {
533			resuming := s.idle[p]
534			if resuming {
535				// A resume watermark must be at least the partition's previous
536				// watermark and the effective watermark produced while it was
537				// idle; equality on either boundary resumes.
538				if prev, ok := s.partWatermark[p]; ok && next < *prev {
539					return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("resume watermark %d for partition %d is below its previous watermark %d", next, p, *prev)}
540				}
541				if s.watermark != nil && next < *s.watermark {
542					return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("resume watermark %d for partition %d is below the current effective watermark %d", next, p, *s.watermark)}
543				}
544				delete(s.idle, p)
545			} else if prev, ok := s.partWatermark[p]; ok && next < *prev {
546				return &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("watermark for partition %d moved backwards from %d to %d", p, *prev, next)}
547			}
548			s.partWatermark[p] = &next
549		}
550	
551		// A watermark update and an idle declaration share one advance-and-close
552		// path from here so both triggers follow the same rules.
553		return s.advanceWatermark(lineNo)

556	// processIdle declares a partition idle: it stops contributing to the
557	// effective watermark until its next watermark record. The declaration
558	// itself may advance the effective watermark and close windows.
559	func (s *aggregateState) processIdle(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, lineNo int) error {
560		p, err := s.requiredPartition(obj, lineNo)
561		if err != nil {
562			return err
563		}
564		if s.idle[p] {
565			// A repeated idle declaration is a no-op: the partition already
566			// stopped contributing, so neither the effective watermark nor the
567			// set of closable windows can change.
568			return nil
569		}
570		s.idle[p] = true
571		// With the partition excluded, the remaining non-idle partitions
572		// determine the effective watermark; the declaration itself can advance
573		// it and close windows, exactly like a watermark update.
574		return s.advanceWatermark(lineNo)
575	}
576	
577	// advanceWatermark applies a partition state change -- a partition watermark
578	// update or an idle declaration -- and closes every window the resulting
579	// watermark allows. Both triggers funnel through here so they follow the
580	// same rules: in partitioned mode the effective watermark is recomputed from
581	// the current partition state (an active partition that has not reported yet
582	// keeps it unknown, and when every partition is idle the last produced value
583	// is retained instead of clearing); in legacy single-watermark mode the
584	// single watermark is used as is. While no effective watermark exists no
585	// window closes; otherwise closeWindows emits every window whose end is less
586	// than or equal to it.
587	func (s *aggregateState) advanceWatermark(lineNo int) error {
588		if s.partitions > 0 {
589			if next := s.effectiveWatermark(); next != nil {
590				s.watermark = next
591			}
592		}
593		if s.watermark == nil {
594			return nil
595		}
596		return s.closeWindows(*s.watermark, lineNo)
597	}
598	
599	// effectiveWatermark returns the minimum watermark over the non-idle
600	// partitions once each of them has reported at least once, or nil
601	// otherwise. When every partition is idle, nil is returned so the caller
602	// keeps the last produced effective watermark.
603	func (s *aggregateState) effectiveWatermark() *int64 {
604		active := s.partitions - int64(len(s.idle))
605		if active <= 0 {
606			return nil
607		}
608		var min int64
609		first := true
610		for p := int64(0); p < s.partitions; p++ {
611			if s.idle[p] {
612				continue
613			}
614			w, ok := s.partWatermark[p]
615			if !ok {
616				return nil
617			}
618			if first || *w < min {
619				min = *w
620				first = false
621			}
622		}
623		return &min
624	}

626	// requiredPartition returns the record's partition index. In legacy mode it
627	// returns 0 without inspecting the record, so extra fields stay ignored.
628	func (s *aggregateState) requiredPartition(obj map[string]json.RawMessage, lineNo int) (int64, error) {
629		if s.partitions == 0 {
630			return 0, nil
631		}
632		p, err := requiredInt64(obj, "partition", lineNo)
633		if err != nil {
634			return 0, err
635		}
636		if p < 0 || p >= s.partitions {
637			return 0, &InputError{Line: lineNo, Reason: fmt.Sprintf("field %q must be an integer in range [0,%d), got %d", "partition", s.partitions, p)}
638		}
639		return p, nil
640	}

642	func (s *aggregateState) closeWindows(watermark int64, lineNo int) error {
643		type pending struct {
644			id windowID
645			st *windowState
646		}
647		var ready []pending
648		for id, st := range s.windows {
649			if st.end <= watermark {
650				ready = append(ready, pending{id: id, st: st})
651			}
652		}
653		sort.Slice(ready, func(i, j int) bool {
654			if ready[i].st.end != ready[j].st.end {
655				return ready[i].st.end < ready[j].st.end
656			}
657			return ready[i].id.key < ready[j].id.key
658		})
659		for _, p := range ready {
660			encoded, err := json.Marshal(AggregateResult{
661				Key:   p.id.key,
662				Start: p.id.start,
663				End:   p.st.end,
664				Count: p.st.count,
665				Sum:   p.st.sum,
666			})
667			if err != nil {
668				return err
669			}
670			line := append(encoded, '\n')
671			if err := writeFull(s.out, line); err != nil {
672				// Stop immediately: the writer may hold zero bytes or only a
673				// prefix of this record, but a truncated record is not a fully
674				// output one, so the window stays open in the map. Do not retry
675				// or resend it and do not emit the remaining ready windows;
676				// content already accepted by the writer stays.
677				return &OutputError{
678					Line:   lineNo,
679					Kind:   "window result",
680					Detail: fmt.Sprintf("key %q window [%d,%d)", p.id.key, p.id.start, p.st.end),
681					Err:    err,
682				}
683			}
684			delete(s.windows, p.id)
685		}
686		return nil
687	}

740		}

743			return 0, fmt.Errorf("field %q must be a signed 64-bit integer, got %s", field, string(trimmed))
744		}
745		value, err := strconv.ParseInt(string(trimmed), 10, 64)
746		if err != nil {

748				return 0, fmt.Errorf("field %q integer out of signed 64-bit range: %s", field, string(trimmed))
749			}

// Command edgefleet is the 验证者与边缘节点机群管理平台 entry point.
package main

import (
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/asdhoaiqqq/edgefleet-validator/edgefleet"
)

func main() {
	command := "demo"
	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
		command = os.Args[1]
	}
	switch command {
	case "demo":
		runDemo()
	case "version":
		fmt.Println("edgefleet 0.1.0")
	case "aggregate":
		os.Exit(runAggregate(os.Args[2:]))
	case "help", "-h", "--help":
		usage()
	default:
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "unknown command %q\n", command)
		usage()
		os.Exit(2)
	}
}

func usage() {
	fmt.Println("usage: edgefleet [demo|version|aggregate --window-ms <milliseconds> [--slide-ms <milliseconds>] [--partitions <count>]|help]")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("commands:")
	fmt.Println("  demo       run a built-in fleet health demonstration")
	fmt.Println("  version    print the edgefleet version")
	fmt.Println("  aggregate  aggregate JSON events from standard input into fixed or sliding windows")
	fmt.Println("  help       show this help")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("aggregate:")
	fmt.Println("  edgefleet aggregate --window-ms <milliseconds> [--slide-ms <milliseconds>] [--partitions <count>]")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("  --window-ms is a required positive signed 64-bit integer. Aggregation runs")
	fmt.Println("  fully offline and never uses the current time; all timing comes from input.")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("  standard input is line-delimited JSON with two record types:")
	fmt.Println(`    {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1200,"value":5}`)
	fmt.Println(`    {"type":"watermark","time":2000}`)
	fmt.Println("  time is a non-negative signed 64-bit millisecond timestamp, value is a")
	fmt.Println("  signed 64-bit integer, and key is a non-empty string. Blank lines are")
	fmt.Println("  ignored, but error line numbers count every physical input line.")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("  windows start at time zero, have the fixed length given by --window-ms")
	fmt.Println("  and are left-closed, right-open: [start,end). Every valid event for a key")
	fmt.Println("  in a window contributes to its count and sum; windows with no events do")
	fmt.Println("  not produce output. Records may arrive out of order; window membership")
	fmt.Println("  uses event time only.")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("  --slide-ms makes the windows overlap: it gives the positive signed")
	fmt.Println("  64-bit integer distance between consecutive window starts (0, one")
	fmt.Println("  interval, two intervals, ...), must not exceed --window-ms and does not")
	fmt.Println("  have to divide it. Each valid event counts once in every window that")
	fmt.Println("  contains its event time, adding its value in full to each of them; for")
	fmt.Println("  example length 1000 with interval 600 produces [0,1000), [600,1600),")
	fmt.Println("  [1200,2200), ... and an event at time 1000 is outside the first. When")
	fmt.Println("  --slide-ms is omitted or equals --window-ms the behavior is identical")
	fmt.Println("  to fixed windows.")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("  a watermark declares that events with time below it are late. Before the")
	fmt.Println("  first watermark every valid event is accepted. After a watermark, every")
	fmt.Println("  window whose end is less than or equal to the watermark is closed once")
	fmt.Println("  and emitted as one JSON line with key,start,end,count,sum; the sum is a")
	fmt.Println("  signed 64-bit integer. Closures are ordered by end ascending and then by")
	fmt.Println("  key in UTF-8 byte order. Watermarks may jump or repeat, and an event at")
	fmt.Println("  exactly the current watermark is still valid; events below the current")
	fmt.Println("  watermark are skipped with a note on standard error, even when they")
	fmt.Println("  would still fall inside an unclosed overlapping window. Still-open")
	fmt.Println("  windows are never emitted at end of input.")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("  --partitions merges several independent input sources of the same stream.")
	fmt.Println("  <count> must be a positive signed 64-bit integer. When it is given, every")
	fmt.Println("  event and watermark record must additionally carry an integer partition in")
	fmt.Println("  [0,count):")
	fmt.Println(`    {"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1200,"value":5,"partition":0}`)
	fmt.Println(`    {"type":"watermark","time":2000,"partition":0}`)
	fmt.Println(`    {"type":"idle","partition":0}`)
	fmt.Println("  each partition advances its own watermark independently. No effective")
	fmt.Println("  watermark exists until every partition has reported at least once;")
	fmt.Println("  afterwards the effective watermark is the minimum of the per-partition")
	fmt.Println("  values, and window closure and late-event checks use that minimum, so one")
	fmt.Println("  partition's larger watermark can never close a window or drop an event")
	fmt.Println("  ahead of the others. A partition watermark may repeat or jump forward but")
	fmt.Println("  never move backwards. Events from different partitions for the same key")
	fmt.Println("  and window merge into one count and sum; output records never include a")
	fmt.Println("  partition field. Sliding windows combine with partitions: the same key")
	fmt.Println("  from different partitions merges within each overlapping window, and the")
	fmt.Println("  effective watermark alone drives late-event checks and closure. Without")
	fmt.Println("  --partitions the command keeps the single watermark behavior and ignores")
	fmt.Println("  extra fields.")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("  an idle record declares a partition temporarily without data. It is")
	fmt.Println("  declared by the input only and is never inferred from the current time")
	fmt.Println("  or read gaps. From that record on the partition is excluded from the")
	fmt.Println("  effective watermark, so it no longer holds the others back; the idle")
	fmt.Println("  record itself may close windows. A non-idle partition that has not")
	fmt.Println("  reported yet still keeps the effective watermark unknown; when every")
	fmt.Println("  partition is idle the last produced effective watermark is retained")
	fmt.Println("  (and stays unknown if none was produced). Idleness is not an infinite")
	fmt.Println("  watermark and does not drop pending events. Repeating an idle record")
	fmt.Println("  for the same partition succeeds without extra output. A partition")
	fmt.Println("  resumes on its next watermark record: its time must be at least both")
	fmt.Println("  its own previous watermark and the current effective watermark. An")
	fmt.Println("  event arriving while the partition is idle is fatal; it neither")
	fmt.Println("  resumes the partition nor is silently treated as late. In single")
	fmt.Println("  watermark mode an idle record is an unknown record type.")
	fmt.Println()
	fmt.Println("  invalid command parameters -- a missing --window-ms, or a")
	fmt.Println("  non-positive --window-ms or --slide-ms, or a --slide-ms larger than")
	fmt.Println("  --window-ms, or a non-positive --partitions -- print the reason to")
	fmt.Println("  standard error and exit non-zero before any input is read. Malformed")
	fmt.Println("  JSON, missing or mistyped fields, out-of-range integers, unknown")
	fmt.Println("  record types, missing or out-of-range partitions, partition watermark")
	fmt.Println("  regression, an event for an idle partition, a resume watermark below")
	fmt.Println("  the partition's previous or the effective watermark, and window-end,")
	fmt.Println("  event-count or cumulative-sum overflow print the input line number and")
	fmt.Println("  reason to standard error and stop processing with a non-zero exit; no")
	fmt.Println("  further records are read and earlier output is retained. A window")
	fmt.Println("  result or late-event notice that cannot be written in full (the")
	fmt.Println("  output writer errors, even after accepting a prefix, or accepts too")
	fmt.Println("  few bytes without an error) is likewise fatal with the triggering")
	fmt.Println("  input line number, the affected key and window or the skipped event")
	fmt.Println("  time and watermark, and the writer's error; the failed content is not")
	fmt.Println("  resent, no further windows are emitted and content already written is")
	fmt.Println("  retained. Standard output contains window results only. A failure while")
	fmt.Println("  reading standard input is likewise fatal: records whose newline was")
	fmt.Println("  received, including those carried by the failing read, are processed in")
	fmt.Println("  order first, but the unterminated trailing bytes never become a record,")
	fmt.Println("  and the reader's error is reported here with a non-zero exit; clean end")
	fmt.Println("  of input is not a read failure, so a final record without a trailing")
	fmt.Println("  newline is still processed.")
}

func runAggregate(args []string) int {
	fs := flag.NewFlagSet("aggregate", flag.ContinueOnError)
	fs.SetOutput(os.Stderr)
	fs.Usage = func() {
		fmt.Fprintln(fs.Output(), "usage: edgefleet aggregate --window-ms <milliseconds> [--slide-ms <milliseconds>] [--partitions <count>]")
		fmt.Fprintln(fs.Output(), `run "edgefleet help" for the full record and window closure rules`)
	}
	windowMillis := fs.Int64("window-ms", 0, "window length in milliseconds (required, positive signed 64-bit integer)")
	slideMillis := fs.Int64("slide-ms", 0, "distance between consecutive window starts in milliseconds (optional positive signed 64-bit integer, no greater than --window-ms); defaults to the window length for non-overlapping fixed windows")
	partitions := fs.Int64("partitions", 0, "number of input partitions (optional positive signed 64-bit integer); when set, every record must carry an integer partition in [0,count)")
	if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
		return 2
	}
	if fs.NArg() != 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "aggregate accepts no positional arguments, got %v\n", fs.Args())
		fs.Usage()
		return 2
	}
	windowSpecified := false
	slideSpecified := false
	partitionsSpecified := false
	fs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) {
		switch f.Name {
		case "window-ms":
			windowSpecified = true
		case "slide-ms":
			slideSpecified = true
		case "partitions":
			partitionsSpecified = true
		}
	})
	if !windowSpecified {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "aggregate requires --window-ms <milliseconds>")
		fs.Usage()
		return 2
	}
	if *windowMillis <= 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "aggregate --window-ms must be a positive signed 64-bit integer, got %d\n", *windowMillis)
		return 2
	}
	if slideSpecified {
		if *slideMillis <= 0 {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "aggregate --slide-ms must be a positive signed 64-bit integer, got %d\n", *slideMillis)
			return 2
		}
		if *slideMillis > *windowMillis {
			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "aggregate --slide-ms %d must not exceed --window-ms %d\n", *slideMillis, *windowMillis)
			return 2
		}
	} else {
		*slideMillis = *windowMillis // omitted: non-overlapping fixed windows
	}
	if partitionsSpecified && *partitions <= 0 {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "aggregate --partitions must be a positive signed 64-bit integer, got %d\n", *partitions)
		return 2
	}
	var err error
	if partitionsSpecified {
		err = edgefleet.RunAggregatePartitionedSliding(os.Stdin, *windowMillis, *slideMillis, *partitions, os.Stdout, os.Stderr)
	} else {
		err = edgefleet.RunAggregateSliding(os.Stdin, *windowMillis, *slideMillis, os.Stdout, os.Stderr)
	}
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "aggregate:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

func runDemo() {
	nodes := []edgefleet.Node{
		{ID: "val-eu-1", Region: "eu", Version: "1.26.0", Online: true},
		{ID: "val-us-1", Region: "us", Version: "1.25.4", Online: true, Missed: 3},
		{ID: "edge-ap-1", Region: "ap", Version: "1.26.0", Online: false},
	}
	unhealthy := 0
	for _, node := range nodes {
		health := edgefleet.Evaluate(node, "1.26.0", 1)
		if !health.Healthy {
			unhealthy++
		}
		fmt.Printf("node=%s healthy=%v findings=%v\n", health.Node, health.Healthy, health.Findings)
	}
	fmt.Println("rollout order:", edgefleet.Plan(nodes, "1.26.0"))
	fmt.Printf("summary: %d of %d nodes need attention\n", unhealthy, len(nodes))
}

  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 --partitions 2
```

标准输出保留失败前已关闭的窗口，标准错误报告物理行号和原因，退出码为 1：

```
{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":5}   # 标准输出
aggregate: line 5: resume watermark 1500 for partition 1 is below the current effective watermark 2000   # 标准错误
```

若该分区休眠前已上报过更高的水位线，则报另一种原因，例如旧水位线为 2500 时用 2400 恢复：

```
aggregate: line 4: resume watermark 2400 for partition 1 is below its previous watermark 2500
```

### 误用二：休眠期间直接发送事件

休眠分区只能用下一条水位线记录恢复，不能直接发事件。下面第 5 行的事件时间 500 虽然已经低于当前整体水位线 1000，但不会按普通迟到事件跳过并记一条迟到日志，而是致命错误（注意第 4 行是空行，空行也计入行号，所以出错的是第 5 行）：

```bash
printf '%s\n' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":100,"value":5,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"idle","partition":1}' \
  '' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":500,"value":1,"partition":1}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":2000,"partition":0}' \
  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 --partitions 2
```

```
{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":5}   # 标准输出
aggregate: line 5: event for idle partition 1 is not allowed; send a watermark to resume it first   # 标准错误
```

这两类失败都会报告物理输入行号和原因、停止处理后续记录（上例中第 6 行的水位线不会再被读取），退出码为 1，但此前已输出的窗口结果全部保留。

### 误用三：key 的字符编码损坏

事件 key 按解码后的原值聚合。key 中任何损坏的字符都不会被修补成替换字符 U+FFFD 后继续计数——否则不同的损坏输入会彼此合并，还会和用户真的以“�”为 key 的结果混在一起。两类损坏都会使该事件成为致命输入错误：key 字符串里的非法 UTF-8 字节序列，以及 JSON `\u` 转义中孤立或配对错误的高、低代理项。例如 `"\uD800"`、`"\uDC00"`、`"\uD800x"` 都必须失败：

```bash
printf '%s\n' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":100,"value":5}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000}' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"x\uDC00","time":200,"value":99}' \
  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000
```

```
{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":5}   # 标准输出
aggregate: line 3: field "key" has damaged character encoding (unpaired low surrogate in Unicode escape) in "x\uDC00"   # 标准错误
```

该事件不改变任何窗口的 count 或 sum；即使其事件时间已低于当前水位线，也是输入错误，而不是只写一条迟到提示后继续。处理立即停止，后续记录不再读取，退出码为 1，此前已完整输出的结果保留，尚未关闭的窗口不补发；空行仍计入错误行号。

合法字符不受影响：中文与补充平面字符正常接收，直接输入“😀”与 `"😀"` 汇入同一个 key；用户直接输入“�”或使用 `"�"` 也是合法字符串，不会因为解码结果含该字符而被拒绝；JSON 里已转义的反斜杠（`"\\uD800"`）只表示字面文本 `\uD800`，按普通文本保留，不会被当成孤立代理项。相同的合法 key 仍合并，不同的合法 key 仍按 UTF-8 字节序各自输出。该规则同样适用于滑动窗口与分区聚合入口。

# 验证者与边缘节点机群管理平台

## 用途

节点注册与身份、心跳与遥测、离线同步、配置分发与滚动升级、罚没与健康规则告警、远程运维记录。

本仓库是可持续演进的自托管 Go 应用。领域核心位于 `edgefleet/`，命令入口位于 `cmd/edgefleet/`。

```bash
go run ./cmd/edgefleet demo
go run ./cmd/edgefleet version
go run ./cmd/edgefleet help
printf '%s\n' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1200,"value":5}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":2000}' \
  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000
go test ./...
```

`aggregate` 从标准输入读取逐行 JSON 事件与水位线记录，按事件时间汇总固定长度窗口（左闭右开，从时间零开始），只在输入水位线推进时输出 end ≤ 水位线的窗口；完全离线，不使用当前时间。可选的 `--slide-ms <milliseconds>` 给出相邻窗口起点的间隔（正数、不大于 `--window-ms`、不要求整除），起点依次为 0、一个间隔、两个间隔，事件会计入所有包含其事件时间的重叠窗口；省略该参数或令其等于窗口长度时与固定窗口行为完全一致。`--partitions <count>` 可合并同一输入流的多个分区：各分区水位线独立推进，全部到齐后整体水位线取各分区最小值，分区字段不进入输出，迟到判断与窗口关闭均使用该整体水位线。分区模式下可用 `{"type":"idle","partition":N}` 显式声明某分区暂时无数据，休眠只由输入声明、不依据时间推断；休眠分区退出整体水位线计算，待下一条不低于其旧水位线和当前整体水位线的水位线记录恢复。详见 `go run ./cmd/edgefleet help`。

## 示例：分区休眠与恢复

下面是一个可直接离线运行的完整示例：两个分区（`--partitions 2`）、1000 毫秒固定窗口（`--window-ms 1000`），围绕同一个 key `sensor-a` 展示从等待到休眠再到恢复的全过程。所有时间均以毫秒计，`time` 为非负的 64 位有符号整数，`value` 为 64 位有符号整数。

命令：

```bash
printf '%s\n' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":100,"value":5,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":200,"value":3,"partition":1}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"idle","partition":1}' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":1100,"value":7,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":2000,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":2000,"partition":1}' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":2100,"value":4,"partition":1}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":3000,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":3000,"partition":1}' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":3100,"value":9,"partition":0}' \
  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 --partitions 2
```

完整的标准输出（进程退出码为 0）：

```json
{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":2,"sum":8}
{"key":"sensor-a","start":1000,"end":2000,"count":1,"sum":7}
{"key":"sensor-a","start":2000,"end":3000,"count":1,"sum":4}
```

两个分区的事件合并进同一个窗口，输出只含 `key`、`start`、`end`、`count`、`sum`，不含分区字段，因此可以直接从输入算出每个结果。逐行说明（行号即物理输入行号）：

- 第 1、2 行：两个分区各来一个事件，事件时间 100 和 200 都落在窗口 `[0,1000)` 内，合并累计 count=2、sum=5+3=8。此时没有任何输出——还没有水位线。
- 第 3 行：分区 0 的水位线推进到 1000，但分区 1 从未上报过水位线，整体水位线尚不存在（不是取已上报分区的值），所以窗口 `[0,1000)` 不关闭，没有新结果。这就是"等待"：一个分区已经推进，另一个分区尚未上报时，只能等后者表态，否则无法判断它是否还有更早的事件在路上。
- 第 4 行：分区 1 显式声明休眠。休眠分区退出整体水位线的最小值计算，剩下的活跃分区只有分区 0，整体水位线立即变为 1000，于是这条休眠记录本身就关闭了窗口 `[0,1000)`，输出第一行结果。可见休眠不是"丢弃"该分区：它已贡献的事件（第 2 行）照常计入，只是不再拖住其他分区。
- 第 5 行：事件落入窗口 `[1000,2000)`，无输出。
- 第 6 行：分区 0 水位线推进到 2000；分区 1 仍在休眠、不参与计算，整体水位线变为 2000，关闭 `[1000,2000)`，输出第二行结果（count=1、sum=7）。
- 第 7 行：分区 1 用水位线记录恢复。恢复水位线必须不低于该分区自己的旧水位线、也不低于当前整体水位线；这里 2000 恰好等于当前整体水位线 2000，取等成功。恢复后整体水位线为 min(2000, 2000) = 2000，没有新窗口可关——已关闭的窗口不会再次输出，所以这一行没有新结果。
- 第 8 行：分区 1 恢复后重新发送事件，落入窗口 `[2000,3000)`，无输出。
- 第 9 行：分区 0 水位线推进到 3000，但恢复后的分区 1 重新参与整体水位线的最小值计算，整体水位线为 min(3000, 2000) = 2000，窗口 `[2000,3000)` 不能关闭，没有新结果。
- 第 10 行：分区 1 水位线推进到 3000，整体水位线变为 3000，关闭 `[2000,3000)`，输出第三行结果（count=1、sum=4）。
- 第 11 行：事件落入窗口 `[3000,4000)`，此后输入结束。结束输入不会补发尚未关闭的窗口——窗口只由水位线（含休眠声明带来的水位线推进）关闭，所以该事件不产生任何输出。

注意：休眠必须由输入用 `{"type":"idle","partition":N}` 显式声明，一段时间没有输入不会被当成自动休眠；休眠也不是无限水位线，不会丢弃该分区已有或待处理的事件。

### 误用一：恢复水位线过低

休眠分区的恢复水位线若低于当前整体水位线，或低于该分区自己休眠前的旧水位线，都会失败。例如整体水位线已到 2000 时用 1500 恢复：

```bash
printf '%s\n' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":100,"value":5,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"idle","partition":1}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":2000,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":1500,"partition":1}' \
  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 --partitions 2
```

标准输出保留失败前已关闭的窗口，标准错误报告物理行号和原因，退出码为 1：

```
{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":5}   # 标准输出
aggregate: line 5: resume watermark 1500 for partition 1 is below the current effective watermark 2000   # 标准错误
```

若该分区休眠前已上报过更高的水位线，则报另一种原因，例如旧水位线为 2500 时用 2400 恢复：

```
aggregate: line 4: resume watermark 2400 for partition 1 is below its previous watermark 2500
```

### 误用二：休眠期间直接发送事件

休眠分区只能用下一条水位线记录恢复，不能直接发事件。下面第 5 行的事件时间 500 虽然已经低于当前整体水位线 1000，但不会按普通迟到事件跳过并记一条迟到日志，而是致命错误（注意第 4 行是空行，空行也计入行号，所以出错的是第 5 行）：

```bash

  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":100,"value":5,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":1000,"partition":0}' \
  '{"type":"idle","partition":1}' \
  '' \
  '{"type":"event","key":"sensor-a","time":500,"value":1,"partition":1}' \
  '{"type":"watermark","time":2000,"partition":0}' \
  | go run ./cmd/edgefleet aggregate --window-ms 1000 --partitions 2
```

```
{"key":"sensor-a","start":0,"end":1000,"count":1,"sum":5}   # 标准输出
aggregate: line 5: event for idle partition 1 is not allowed; send a watermark to resume it first   # 标准错误
```

content.subject: Strict key decoder: reject invalid UTF-8 and unpaired surrogate escapes
content.description: Add lossless JSON string decoder for event keys in edgefleet/aggregate.go: reject invalid UTF-8 bytes and lone/mismatched \u surrogate escapes instead of U+FFFD replacement; keep literal U+FFFD, �, and escaped backslash valid. Wire into processEvent before late/window logic, update doc comments and CLI usage text.

content.subject: Add tests for damaged-key rejection and valid Unicode aggregation
content.description: Library tests: lone/mismatched surrogates, invalid UTF-8, line numbers (blanks count), no state mutation/stop, below-watermark fatal, valid CJK/emoji merge across direct and escaped forms, literal U+FFFD and \\uD800 text legal, sliding and partitioned entries. CLI test: exit 1, stderr reason+line, earlier stdout retained.

## 修改内容

**`edgefleet/aggregate.go`** — 核心修正：
- 新增 `decodeKeyStrict`（`aggregate.go:771`），一个无损 JSON 字符串解码器，取代 key 原来使用的 `json.Unmarshal`（标准库会把两类损坏静默替换成 U+FFFD）：
  - key 字符串中**非法 UTF-8 字节序列** → `invalid UTF-8 byte sequence`；
  - `\u` 转义中**孤立/错配的代理项**（高代理 0xD800–0xDBFF 后必须紧跟低代理 0xDC00–0xDFFF；低代理单独出现即非法）→ `unpaired high/low surrogate in Unicode escape`。
- 新增 `requiredKey` 并在 `processEvent` 最前面调用。该函数是固定窗口、滑动窗口、分区、分区+滑动四个入口的共享路径，因此修正同时覆盖全部入口。
- 校验发生在迟到判断和任何窗口更新**之前**：损坏 key 的事件不改任何 count/sum，即使事件时间低于水位线也报 `*InputError`（带物理行号，空行计入），而不是写迟到提示后继续；处理随即停止，后续记录不再处理，已输出结果保留，未关闭窗口不补发。
- 合法情形保持原样：直接输入"😀"与 `"\uD83D\uDE00"` 解码为同一 key 并合并；直接输入"�"和 `"\uFFFD"` 合法且合并；`"\\uD800"`（转义的反斜杠）按字面文本 `\uD800` 保留；中文及其他合法字符不变。

**`cmd/edgefleet/main.go`** — 复用现有的 stderr + 退出码 1 通道输出 `InputError`；`help` 文案补充编码损坏这一致命输入类别及合法例外。
